integrity: The equations and proof are self-contained up to standard gamma/Mittag–Leffler asymptotics. Finite computations are diagnostics, not proofs. Publication priority remains subject to independent literature review.
scientific_limitations: The construction is for positive integer radial exponent, positive real strict dilation and a specified Mittag–Leffler entire weight; no assertion for arbitrary real exponents or all weighted compositions.
Truncated Hilbert–Schmidt energy is a spatial integral, not an eigenvalue/singular-value truncation.
The Gaussian existence phenomenon was previously published; the new cross-power asymptotic is not an independent bibliographic uniqueness claim.
Independent mathematical and publication-priority validation has not been performed.
title: A universal quarter-order Hilbert–Schmidt transition for integer-power Fock compositions
